statement: Pinned Linux hid-nintendo exposes left-half D-pad directions as BTN_DPAD keys rather than a hat axis, maps Minus to BTN_SELECT, Capture to BTN_Z, L to BTN_TL, ZL to BTN_TL2 and left-stick click to BTN_THUMBL; it maps SL to BTN_TR and SR to BTN_TR2 only outside the USB Charging Grip.

applicability.revision: Linux 4056b3c9d3c92ea45955641dbafeb9b960e146ef; SDL3 535d80badefc83c5c527ec5748f2a20d6a9310fe; source-only; no host or hardware
applicability.scope: Linux per-half evdev mapping at pinned revision. Grip exclusion is a consumer policy, not measured rail-state bytes.
